subject: Request: additional accelerator credits & extended expiry
messages:
From: Sophie Martin <sophie@launchscale.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@innovo.co>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Accelerator cohort — extra credits and expiry ask

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — LaunchScale's team loved the latency and cost controls. We're finalizing the benefits list for our Winter cohort (starting Jan 11) and I wanted to check if Redwood can make a small exception on the standard starter credits.

Current ask: 200k free token credits per company (standard is 50k) and a 12-month expiry rather than 3 months. Our accelerator covers 12 startups and we expect a few teams to prototype at scale during the program; 50k will be eaten up by a single demo.

I understand this is outside policy — happy to provide more details about usage patterns and success metrics. If helpful, Samir (cc'd) can share last cohort's usage profile.

Appreciate any flexibility you can provide — big potential for downstream paid adoption.

Best,
Sophie Martin
Program Director, LaunchScale Labs
Sophie@launchscale.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie@launchscale.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Accelerator cohort — extra credits and expiry ask

Hi Sophie — great to hear the team found the demo useful.

Short answer: we can consider a cohort exception but need to scope guardrails so the offer doesn't create open-ended costs or abuse. A few clarifying Qs to help us evaluate quickly:

- Are the 12 startups incubator-stage (pre-revenue / seed) or growth-stage?
- Do you expect most teams to use generation (chat) or embeddings-heavy workloads?
- Is there an MAM (mutual action plan) or acceptance criteria for the accelerator to drive paid conversions?

Prelim proposal from my side (subject to approvals):
- 150k token credits per company, 9 month expiry
- Usage cap: soft daily limit with automatic throttling once cohort-wide consumption exceeds forecast; overrides require approval
- Custom onboarding + 2 office hours with our solutions team to optimize batching/quantization

If that's acceptable I can loop in Dev to approve the exception and produce a one-page terms addendum. Also copying Tessa from growth to align on conversion KPIs.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
From: Sophie Martin <sophie@launchscale.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@innovo.co>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Accelerator cohort — extra credits and expiry ask

Thanks Grace — helpful framing. Answers below and a short snapshot attached.

- Stage: 9 teams are pre-seed/seed, 3 are early revenue ( <$500k ARR )
- Workloads: roughly 60% embeddings (search/rerank), 35% chat/assistant, 5% experiments with fine-tuning/ops
- Conversion: cohort terms require a demo + short case study; historically our partners convert ~25% to paid in 6-12 months. We will share a conversion road map and require participants to sign a lightweight MOU committing to the demo/case-study ask.

The 150k/9-month proposal looks reasonable — would you consider extending expiry to 12 months if we include a mandatory post-program adoption review and 2x co-marketing mentions?

Attached: pilot_usage_snapshot.csv (last year's cohort)

Sophie

On Sat, Nov 28, 2026 at 13:05 Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Sophie — great to hear the team found the demo useful.
>
> Short answer: we can consider a cohort exception but need to scope guardrails so the offer doesn't create open-ended costs or abuse...
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie@launchscale.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 17:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Accelerator cohort — extra credits and expiry ask

Hi Sophie — thanks for the context and the usage snapshot. I reviewed the numbers with finance and growth. We're prepared to make a one-time exception with the following terms (finalized for signatures):

- Credits: 150,000 token credits per company (cohort of 12)
- Expiry: 12 months from issuance date
- Controls: cohort-wide soft daily cap and per-account throttles; any overage requires pre-approval and will be billable at list rates
- Deliverables: each cohort participant signs an MOU committing to a demo and a short case study; LaunchScale commits to two co-marketing activities (webinar + blog) as part of the program
- Onboarding: 2x solutions office hours + a technical onboarding guide (attached: Accelerator_Terms_v2.pdf)
- Legal: terms addendum to be executed via DocuSign (link below). No change to Redwood's standard Data Processing Addendum.

I'll add these to a short DocuSign envelope and share the link: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abc123

Please confirm and we'll kick off the one-page addendum. Once signed, we will provision credits within 3 business days.

Thanks —
Dev Patel
Director, Partnerships (on behalf of Sales Ops)
Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai
